abstract: Testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs) are a clinically and pathologically heterogeneous disease, and little is known of its genetic basis. Only low susceptibility risk loci have been identified for both sporadic and familial cases. Therefore, we tried to identify new susceptibility genes responsible for familial testicular cancer that may contribute to increasing our knowledge about the genetic basis of the disease. Nineteen Spanish families with at least two affected individuals with TGCT were selected. WES was performed on those individuals using an Illumina Hiseq2000 sequencing platform. Data were analyzed under a monogenic and polygenic model of inheritance, and candidate variants were evaluated in a case-control association study performed on 391 Spanish sporadic cases and 1,170 healthy Spanish controls. Results were replicated in a second series consisting of 101 TGCTs from the Cancer Genome Atlas (TGCA) and 27,000 controls from the Exome Aggregation Consortium (ExAC) database. Logistic regression was carried out to analyze the association strength (risk) of candidate variants obtained among cases and controls in different populations. Despite the sample size, we detected a significant earlier age of onset in familial TGCT (28y) than sporadic cases (33y), using a Mann-Whitney U test. We identified significant variants in the comparative study of TGCT cases (391) versus controls (almost 1,170), and three of them [PLEC (OR = 6.28, p = 6.42 × 10(-23) ) (p.Arg2016Trp), EXO5 (OR = 3.37, p = 4.82 × 10(-09) ) (p.Arg344AlafsTer10) and DNAH7 (OR = 1.64, p = 0.048)] were replicated as potential candidates that may contribute to explaining the genetic basis of TGCT.
abstract_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)は臨床的・病理学的に異質性の高い疾患であり、その遺伝学的基盤はほとんど分かっていない。孤発例と家族例のいずれについても、低リスクの感受性遺伝子座しか同定されていない。そこで我々は、精巣がんの遺伝学的基盤の理解を深めるため、家族性精巣がんの原因となりうる新規感受性遺伝子の同定を試みた。TGCTの罹患者を少なくとも2名含むスペイン人家系19家系を選択した。これらの個体に対してIllumina HiSeq2000シーケンシングプラットフォームを用いて全エクソーム解析(WES)を行った。データは単一遺伝子モデルおよび多遺伝子モデルの遺伝形式の下で解析し、候補バリアントは、スペイン人の孤発例391例と健常対照1,170例を用いた症例対照関連解析で評価した。結果は、Cancer Genome Atlas(TCGA)由来のTGCT 101例およびExome Aggregation Consortium(ExAC)データベース由来の対照27,000例からなる第二の集団で再現性を確認した。異なる集団における症例と対照から得られた候補バリアントの関連の強さ(リスク)を解析するためにロジスティック回帰を行った。症例数は限られるものの、Mann-Whitney U検定により、家族性TGCTの発症年齢(28歳)は孤発例(33歳)より有意に若いことが示された。TGCT症例(391例)と対照(約1,170例)の比較解析で有意なバリアントを同定し、そのうち3つ〔PLEC(OR = 6.28, p = 6.42 × 10⁻²³)(p.Arg2016Trp)、EXO5(OR = 3.37, p = 4.82 × 10⁻⁹)(p.Arg344AlafsTer10)、DNAH7(OR = 1.64, p = 0.048)〕が、TGCTの遺伝学的基盤の説明に寄与しうる候補として再現された。
